cands.bio: Democrat who has served in the Alabama State Senate for District 23 since November 2022. Accountant and tax and disclosure advocate. Former district staffer in the U.S. House. Tuskegee University graduate (2012) with a graduate degree from Kennesaw State University (2016).
cands.gaps: We found no documented positions or actions by Stewart on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreigners, growth and land conservation, immigration or H-1B, police and public order, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The page we had lists his sponsored bills only as a table with no readable content, so we could not describe any specific bill. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and his 2022 survey answers were general (economic development, healthcare, education, tax policy, consumer protection, labor policy). We found no stated birth year, no information about his upbringing beyond the 2022 survey's wording, and no documented controversies or foreign ties. His committee assignments are known but are not counted as actions. We found no notable endorsements beyond inclusion in several voter-guide groups on Ballotpedia.

cands.name: Thayer "Bear" Havard Spencer
cands.bio: Retired healthcare professional with 36 years in the healthcare industry, specializing in dementia programs and senior housing. Served in the U.S. Navy Medical Corps from 1991 to 1994. Ran for Alabama State Senate District 23 in 2026. Has not held elected office.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Spencer was born or raised, or when he moved to Alabama. His Ballotpedia page lists Alexandria Senior High but does not say which Alexandria. We found no record of any elected office held. We found no stated positions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, development, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or schools. His own campaign themes were elder abuse protections, online bullying and defamation accountability, and saving historic buildings. We found no endorsements; he told Ballotpedia he had none at this time. We found no news coverage or controversies about him. We did not see a campaign website or interviews. His only source was a Ballotpedia profile built partly from his own survey answers.
